content: Decision: Created 16 follow-up issues (#3-#18) for leaf function replacements. Organized by priority: high-priority leaves (#3-#7) are either trivial wins or high-value unlocks (bcf_unpack unlocks 10+ functions, bcf_hdr_id2int unlocks all data access, bam_aux_get unlocks all aux updates). Medium priority (#8-#11, #15) covers module-level leaf groups. Low priority (#12-#14, #16-#18) covers less impactful leaves.
